title: CPH2583_16.0.9.400(EX01) is available
description:
New version: CPH2583_16.0.9.400(EX01)Home screen & Lock screen

• A wider selection of custom fingerprint icons and animations is now available. You can find this feature in "Settings - Home screen, Lock screen & style - More - Fingerprint animation".

• Improves transition animations when opening and switching apps in "Recent Tasks," resulting in a faster, more fluid multitasking experience.

Device Connect

• You can now lock your PC remotely with a single tap. After your phone connects to your PC remotely, you can unlock your PC directly from the phone without entering your PC's password.

Security & privacy

• Integrates the July 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1
